name: Team 1 Table and Plot Agent
description: Extract tables by caption from uploaded Markdown, plot chosen columns from table artifacts or uploaded CSV/TSV, and list available tables. Parsing is deterministic; semantic matching never invents data.

skills.name: Team 1: extract a captioned table
skills.description: Find the table described by the user in an uploaded Markdown document and publish it as a CSV table artifact with exact headers and values.
skills.usage_notes: Use for extracting a table from a .md upload, including population, rainfall, temperature, or other caption descriptions. Pass document_artifact_id and the natural-language table_query. For a request to extract AND plot, call this first, then pass the returned artifact_id to team1_plot_table; do not ask for a CSV first. Never use this for CSV uploads.
skills.output_format: JSON with artifact_id, table_artifact_id, caption, columns, numeric_columns and row_count; emits a text/csv table artifact.

document_artifact_id.description: Uploaded Markdown document artifact ID in this conversation.

table_query.description: User description of the wanted table by subject or caption; preserve their wording. Optional when the document has one table.

skills.name: Team 1: plot tabular data
skills.description: Render a PNG plot from an extracted table artifact or an uploaded CSV/TSV. Match requested column names and ask with actual column dropdowns when unspecified.
skills.usage_notes: Use directly for CSV/TSV uploads. For Markdown, use team1_extract_table first and pass its artifact_id here. Supply exact x_column and y_columns when known, or put the original user plot request in plot_query. Leave axes absent for vague requests such as plot this; the skill loads the file and asks dropdown questions offering its real columns. Do not guess axes or fill all numeric columns for an unspecified plot. For multiple series, either list the exact column names in y_columns, or pass a single collective phrase such as 'all villages' or 'each village' as one y_columns entry; the skill expands it against the table's real headers and excludes total/average columns unless the request mentions them. Never pass file contents as parameters.
skills.output_format: JSON with PNG artifact_id, selected x_column/y_columns, chart_type, rows, missing_values and x_rows_omitted; emits an image/png artifact.

table_artifact_id.description: CSV/TSV upload or table artifact ID returned by extraction.

plot_query.description: Original natural-language plotting request, including the desired series and axes. For plot this, pass that wording and leave axes absent.

x_column.description: Requested x-axis column or semantic name, only if explicitly specified by the user.

y_columns.description: Requested numeric y-axis column names; may contain several series. Only fill when requested.

y_column.description: One numeric y-axis column; used when answering the agent dropdown.

chart_type.description: Optional style. Auto selects line for time, scatter for numeric comparisons, or bar for categories.

title.description: Optional title explicitly requested by the user; otherwise use the table caption.

skills.name: Team 1: list document tables
skills.description: List actual captions, column names and row counts for every table in an uploaded Markdown file.
skills.usage_notes: Use when the user asks what tables are available or needs help choosing a table; does not plot or invent data.
skills.output_format: JSON listing captions, columns, rows and source_line.
